proved: One authorization binds the exact question and source bytes, full protocol call graph, call IDs, phase order, provider/model routes, dependencies, judgment presentation order, final-pass flag, per-call timeout and output ceiling, per-route budgets, total budget, and compute-matched baseline.

The Rust registry stores only a random 256-bit capability, content identity, route/call state, dependency output hashes, budgets, and expiry for at most 30 minutes; denial stores no authority and explicit revocation is available.

Atomic reservation consumes each call and both budgets once, rejects graph/content/route/budget substitution, refuses duplicates under concurrent attempts, and accepts dependency bytes only when their SHA-256 matches a successful prior authorized output.

The product Tauri command uses the same tested native executor that derives phase instructions, retrieves an OS-vault credential, dispatches through a built-in provider transport, validates phase-specific strict JSON, records successful output hashes, and authors content-free provider run records.

Loopback transport tests prove the approved question/source bytes and derived phase instructions enter the request while the credential, research bytes, and authorization capability do not enter the serialized outcome or run record.
Malformed remote output is rejected, remains consumed, and is not recorded as a dependency.

The frontend executes the exact frozen graph, forwards only exact raw completed upstream bytes, rejects arbitrary graph nodes and malformed, extra-field, private-reasoning, or usage-free results, and revokes authorization after the run.
The assembled research result remains pending human review and has sharedMutation.applied false.

MCP start derives sources only from selected blocks of the exact live document revision, returns a job immediately, restricts routes to built-in remote providers, caps active jobs at eight, heartbeats every 30 seconds, aborts at 15 minutes, retains terminal state for one hour, and exposes inspect/cancel without shared mutation authority.
